source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
An **[Unengaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** unit that did not [Advance](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) this turn and has at least 1 **[[INDIRECT FIRE]](vsdata:weapon-ability/indirect-fire)** weapon can shoot this way, following [Making Attacks](vsdata:core-rule/making-attacks). Its **[[INDIRECT FIRE]](vsdata:weapon-ability/indirect-fire)** weapons can target units their firers cannot see. For each such attack:

- the target gets the **[Benefit of Cover](vsdata:core-rule/benefit-of-cover)**
- the **Hit roll** cannot be re-rolled
- an unmodified Hit roll fails on 1–5, or on 1–3 if a friendly unit can see the target and the firing unit has **[Remained Stationary](vsdata:core-rule/remain-stationary)** this turn

For the rest of the phase the unit cannot **start an action**.
